findings.finding: Legal charges are partly counted twice. The 19.881B litigation claim (legal-related accruals 11.577B current + 8.304B non-current at 2026-09-30, 10-Q) is subtracted as debt-like, and that part is correct: balance-sheet debt is only long-term debt 80.922B + current portion 2.747B = 83.669B, opening debt 116.05B = 83.669 + 12.5 preferred + 19.881 litigation exactly, other_claims 0, so the bridge has no double count. But the margin path starts from the TTM GAAP operating margin of 32.9% (anchors.ttm operating_income 79.38B / revenue 241.606B). That TTM figure already includes the 9.89B Q3 2026 attorneys-general charge and the 2.4B Q2 2026 legal charges, the same accruals that sit in the 19.881B claim. Without those 12.29B the TTM margin is about 37.9%. The base path climbs from 32.9% to 37.0% over 6 years, and the bear's 30% is set as the base minus 7 points, so years 1 to 5 carry the accrued charge as an operating cost a second time. Rough size: about 4 points of margin in year 1 falling to about 1 point in year 6, roughly 12 to 15 USD a share on the base (under 2%). The error is conservative and does not reverse the verdict. A recurring legal allowance can be defended (legal charges recur as a category, pack note 'dc ONEOFF'), but the specific accrued settlement cannot be both a cost in the margin and a claim.

findings.finding: Asymmetric bridge for the preferred. The 6.50% Series A mandatory convertible preferred was issued on 2026-10-29, after the 2026-09-30 balance sheet. Its 12.5B liquidation amount is subtracted as a claim, but the issue proceeds (about 12.5B gross, a little less net) are not added to cash: bridge_events [], investment_adjustments []. The fc assumption 'bridge' says post-balance-sheet financing is not reflected. Counting the claim without the cash understates value by about 4.8 USD a share. Combined with the excluded forward sale (+4 USD), the base is understated by about 9 USD (about 1%). The fc assumption 'claims' also still says 'No preferred stock ... recorded', which contradicts debt_like_claims[0].

findings.finding: Non-marketable equity investments of 32.624B (Q3 2026 10-Q balance sheet; 28.41B at Q1) are left out of the opening investments. Opening marketable_investments of 74.352B = marketable securities 71.227B + 3.125B listed stakes. The dataqa note says long-term investments were 'untagged ... taken as zero only provisionally; confirm on the balance sheet', and the balance sheet does show them. Some of this is strategic and illiquid (for example the 20% equity-method stake in the Louisiana data-center Venture), so leaving it out is a defensible conservative choice. But it is not stated, and at book value it is worth about 12.8 USD a share.

findings.finding: The AG settlement installments (about 12.7B over 10 years) sit inside the 19.881B accrual and are subtracted at face value with no discounting. That is conservative and small, and the 5.3B contingent amount is correctly left out of the claim because it is not accrued. The rest checks out against the casefile: price 614 (after-hours last trade on 2026-10-30 versus the 614.99 close, per review/trace.json), fair value 875 = base_value 874.61, the 5-year potential rows (+85% / +227% / -26% = 1,136 / 2,005 / 454 against 614), base IRR 12.4%, the yearly path prices (company_path economics, ROIC 0.10/0.20/0.30, base multiple 21.2x falling to 17.0x against own median 27.1x, so no peak multiple is paid), and ran true with every stage ok. Current-year revenue is 256.213B = YTD 181.713B + the Q4 guide midpoint 74.5B, with the track-record ratio 1.041 (7 of 7 beats) NOT applied, which is conservative and visible.
